experiment_data.hypothesis: Pretrained N-scaling: SciERC N=32 with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (unfinetuned). Tests whether pretrained MV advantage persists at higher N, and whether per-type direction flip (pretrained positive vs finetuned negative) holds at N=32. Complements finetuned N=32 for generalization evidence. Addresses reviewer concern about generalization beyond finetuned setting.
